title: Unit Event — Start Rolling! Stars' Crossing — Episode5 The Stage is Set

meta.Event Outline: The Lumina Grand Prix has come at last. The preliminary stage will take place in a specially-built glamorous accommodation facility! A nervous Minori throws herself into life on camera alongside a colorful array of rivals, but she soon meets hurdles.

rows.Line: The next day
The Lumina Forum - Cafeteria

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Oh, Shizuku, you also got the salmon belly set?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because the omelets that came with it looked so delicious.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! They're so plump and shiny! You can tell that a pro made them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now that we're all here, why don't we get started.
Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm...! This salmon's so rich with fat that it just melts in your mouth! I can't believe we get to have something so delicious for breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's MMJ!>
<Even in the morning, Shizuku looks divine.>
<Their breakfast looks delicious!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? I think we're on camera right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right! Morning, everyone!
Check out how this salmon belly glistens! And it tastes—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori seems all better now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. That means the four of us are back to full strength!
se_walk_women_002_4
Excuse me. Would it be alright if we sat with you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
ReLight's here...!
Yes, sit and have breakfast with us!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Akari, why don't you sit next to Momoi...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Y-You really don't have to do that! I'll take the seat, though!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see that you got the ginger fried pork set, Hagiyama.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Yes, because I don't like dealing with fish bones... I usually avoid those kinds of dishes whenever I eat out.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Yu's more unsophisticated than you realize.
For one, she can't cook at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? That's a bit surprising.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This feels a little strange...
I mean, we're having breakfast with ReLight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We're probably going to see a lot of each other, so we look forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Likewise! We're really glad that we get to do something with MORE MORE JUMP! again.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: We may be rivals, but our feelings are probably the same...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our feelings...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: But we want to become idols who can make people all across Japan smile through our singing and dancing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's do our best to spread hope to as many people as we can and make them all smile!
se_event_crossing_2025_001
<Good morning, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Take a look at that monitor.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Hey, isn't that Aya-P...?
What do you think she's gonna say?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <I know this is sudden, but this competition's very first Lumina Time will begin shortly!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here we go...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's Lumina Time... What do you think they're gonna have us do?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <Your first task will be announced in the main ballroom in one hour! We ask those who are interested in participating to please be there! See you then!>
se_event_crossing_2025_002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it went black.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In one hour.
That's not a lot of time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We need to get changed, do our makeup and take care of a bunch of other stuff. But first, let's get in a good breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
One hour later
The Lumina Forum - Ballroom

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
I see plenty of you here!
Also, now that it's time, no further requests for entry will be accepted.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's the very first Lumina Time.
I'm sure you're all wondering what exactly it's going to entail.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
So, let's get right to it!
The theme this time around is...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: An “Appealing Talk Show”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Appealing...?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
The rules are simple.
We'll provide you with various topics, and your job will be to inform our viewers about you and your group!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: However, only one member from each group will be allowed to speak!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: There will be a separate MC present, but it'll be on all of you to keep the conversation going.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I see...
In other words, this isn't just a matter of us making an appeal about ourselves.)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: In addition, the talk show will be broadcast on KyoTV, so it'll be a chance for you all to make an appeal to the viewers watching there!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: We'll begin right here in thirty minutes, so please make sure to choose a representative by then. Anyway, I'll see you all again soon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, who should we have go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Talk shows are Airi's wheelhouse...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But there might be more to consider. Why don't we discuss this in a meeting room since we still have some time...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's sort all the information we have.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: So, who do you think is gonna appear?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Hikarin for sure since she's flying solo.
Which means it'd be extremely helpful to have people like Arisa or Airi present since they're so great at coming up with quips and keeping conversations going...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
I'm sure Arisa's going to be there.
She understands her strengths very well, and I'm sure she'll want to take the spotlight as the leader.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
As for Airi...
I'd say she's a 50-50 chance.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Hm, you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Still, a talk show...
It seems appropriate to open with one, but it also feels like an ordinary choice.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Oh, are you so sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I think it's important for them to get to know one another since they're going to be spending quite a lot of time together here.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: So, I'm sure this show will quickly bear fruit.
